headline: Wild place two players on waivers for Nov. 9
take:
Daily Faceoff reports the Wild placed Cameron Crotty and Tyler Pitlick on waivers for Nov. 9, and says both could be heading down to the AHL. The data lists Crotty with OTT, so we can't confirm from our numbers which club he was with, and we'd treat that as a question mark until the transaction is clear.

Pitlick is the one we can read. He is pointless in 12 games so far this season, but he has barely played, averaging 7.64 minutes. His shot quality sits about 1.6 goals below what his chances should have produced (1.62 expected, none scored), which looks like bad finishing on a tiny sample rather than a real flaw. At 5-on-5, MIN has had 52.83% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice, so he hasn't hurt them. For a MIN team at 12-3-4 with 56.4% of expected goals, sending down a fourth-liner barely shifts anything. Crotty played just 3 games, so there's nothing to learn from his numbers.
